title: Agent Output Contract
description: Specialist agent output object per AIDD §2.2. Validated by grounding gate before synthesis.

supporting_data.description: Mandatory citation set. Required if answer contains any numeric/factual claim. Validated by grounding test gate (Testing Strategy §1.2).

confidence.description: Calibration checked against historical correction rate (AIDD §7)

caveats.description: Explicit scope gaps. May be empty array, never omitted.

suggested_actions.description: Proposals only — this agent never executes

model_used.description: Exact model identifier, logged for reproducibility (Testing Strategy §5)

source_system.description: Which integration/system this data came from (e.g., 'quickbooks', 'linear', 'agent_inference')

source_ref.description: Record/entity ID in the source system, or description if agent_inference

value.description: The actual data value being cited

payload.description: Exact content to be executed. Schema varies by action_type.

risk_tier.description: Set by platform-level lookup table. Agent's value is VALIDATED and OVERRIDDEN if it disagrees (AIDD GR-04, SGD §2).

rationale.description: Why this action is proposed, referencing supporting_data
